title: Purgatory
author: Lorenzo Cellier
description:
A Horror Story of Redemption

Do your choices define who you are, when you have no choice? You sit at your desk, looking at the skyscrapers. You can’t stop thinking about that half-smile. And the wooden cabin. Your bladder is about to give up. But there is an email from your boss, waiting. Will you open the cutlery drawer in the kitchen before going to his office? You cannot remember if you have been here before.

Content warning: Graphic and implied violence, foul language, body horror, depression, suicide.
